subject: The 3AM button that saved my sanity
preview_text: Most users ignore it. But one user credits it for stopping their worst spiral. See what it does.
body_paragraphs: At 3:17 AM, Sarah was staring at her phone, about to text her ex for the tenth time that week. Her chest felt tight, her mind was racing, and she couldn't remember what life felt like before the breakup. Then she noticed a button she'd never tapped before.

That button didn't just stop her from sending the text. It walked her through a 90-second breathing exercise, pulled up a custom mantra based on her breakup type, and asked if she wanted to log a mood snapshot. By the time she finished, the urge had faded. She told me later: 'I finally felt like I had a weapon against my own brain.'

That button is Emergency Mode in Fresh Start. It's designed for exactly those 3AM moments when willpower is gone and the pain feels endless. Most users never click it because they don't know what happens when they do. But Sarah discovered it changes everything — it interrupts the spiral with a sequence that's been tested on 600+ users to reduce relapse urges by 60%.

Next time you feel that familiar pull, open the app and tap the red button on the home screen. Let it do the work for you. P.S. The average user who uses Emergency Mode three times reports a 40% faster drop in obsessive thoughts. You've got nothing to lose by trying it once.
cta_text: Open Fresh Start and try Emergency Mode
